reviewNotes: Reviewed all 159 keys against source furigana. Whole-word annotations (e.g. 刻む(きざむ), 薄切り(うすぎり)) are explicitly transcribed where the shared cleaner leaves kanji. Checked voiced cutting compounds みじんぎり/かくぎり/うすぎり/せんぎり/たんざくぎり. Topic は is わ, object を is お; lexical は in はっこう, はたらき, はじめる, はやく, はげしく is preserved. Arrow sequences use pauses; English question tails are excluded. Individual choice clips and whole-choice clips have matching readings. No audible pitch certification.
